query: SELECT managed_url.deployment_id AS "deployment_id!: Uuid", managed_url.port AS "port!", CONCAT(managed_url.sub_domain, '.', workspace_domain.name, '.', workspace_domain.tld) AS "host!" FROM managed_url INNER JOIN deployment ON managed_url.deployment_id = deployment.id INNER JOIN workspace_domain ON managed_url.domain_id = workspace_domain.id WHERE managed_url.deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND managed_url.port IS NOT NULL AND deployment.runner = $1;
